exposure: location/timing of palliation (at referring hospital vs. after transfer to accepting hospital)
outcome: need for resuscitation including chest compressions
cohort: The cohort consisted of 60 infants referred to a neonatal retrieval service between December 2015 and March 2022, who died either during retrieval or within 7 days of referral.
finding: Infants palliated at the referring hospital were more likely to require significant medical interventions during stabilization (resuscitation, hypotension, pneumothorax) compared to those transported and palliated later, but less likely to require seizure management.
